tool_args.rationale: The thermal-fin bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, but the constant s_grad pilot leaves its sink dependence and open branch ambiguous. The targeted probe can distinguish these mechanisms at lower cost than a trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the thermal-fin bridge siphon immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so sink inhibition and branch contributions cannot be independently identified or confirmed across gradients.
The thermal-fin and flux-conservation signatures point to the static siphon bridge; the pilot does not specifically establish a coupled memory ODE.
They can mimic the fixed-gradient pilot but cannot distinguish the archived sink-dependent mechanisms.
